message.content: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard, originally introduced by Anthropic, that lets AI applications connect to external systems through a common interface instead of custom one-off integrations. In practice, an MCP client (like an AI assistant) talks to MCP servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts—so the model can fetch data or take actions in services such as databases, file systems, or SaaS APIs.
